messages.subject: could not find function "dwish"
parts:
Hi, all. When I am trying to run the nimble with the following code, it returns that  could not find function "dwish".
Do you have any idea about what's going on here?

Here is my code:
GEF.MultiSite.Nimble.test <-  nimbleCode({
  X.mod[1:156] ~ dmnorm(mean = muf[1:156], cov = pf[1:156, 1:156])
  if (q.type == 4) {
    for (i in 1:39) {
      q[i, 1:3, 1:3] <- dwish(R = aq[i, 1:3, 1:3], df = bq[i])
      X[i, 1:3]  ~ dmnorm(Xs[1:3], prec = q[i, 1:3, 1:3])
      y.censored[i, 1:3] ~ dmnorm(X[i, 1:3], prec = r[i, 1:3, 1:3])
    }
  }
})
Thank you!

messages.author: 442b578d148ed4d1
messages.subject: Re: could not find function "dwish"
parts:
Hi Dongchen,

I noticed that you used '<-' instead of '~' in the definition of q[,,]. Is this what you meant? It looks to me like you are assigning a distribution to q[i,1:3,1:3] and so want 

q[i, 1:3, 1:3] ~ dwish(R = aq[i, 1:3, 1:3], df = bq[i])

Hope that helps!

Simon
